title: Lemonade Policy Coverage Amount Leaderboard
dataSources: Lemonade policies (`lemonade:policy`), home claims (`claim:home`), premium bills (`homeinsurance:premium`), and renewal offers (`homeinsurance:renewal`).
app: Lemonade policy exports, home claim filings, premium billing snapshots, renewal offer logs, and coverage review notes streamed into Splunk HEC under `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lemonade:policy coverage_usd=*
| stats sum(coverage_usd) as total_value, avg(coverage_usd) as avg_value by policy_type
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks policy type values by total and average coverage amount across Lemonade policy events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `coverage_usd` values for each Lemonade policy event and review total and average coverage amount by policy type.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total coverage amount.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which policy type shows the biggest coverage amount numbers in your Lemonade policy data.
